verdict.line: You lose if you dash into a loaded Rupture and get silenced before your burst lands; you win if you hook him down the instant Rupture goes on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's only hard CC is Rupture (Q, 9s cooldown, 950 range, knockup + slow) — once it's thrown, he has nothing but Vorpal Spikes autos and a 300-range Feral Scream silence to stop your all-in for a full 9 seconds. Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope (800 range) outranges that silence window, so every Rupture miss or Rupture-on-cooldown moment is a green light to hook, yank, and burst him with Violent Tendencies before he can reset.

theirWindow.when: Rupture is up and you're in melee range
theirWindow.what: Don't dash E in on cooldown-less Cho — if he lands Rupture's knockup/slow he can follow with Feral Scream's silence and shut your Q/W combo down entirely before you deal damage.

yourWindow.what: Hook him with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range) the moment Rupture is down — his only answer for the next 9 seconds is Vorpal Spikes autos. Yank him in, pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the 4 empowered attacks, and Joust (E) through for the extra hit.

powerCurve.note: Vorpal Spikes punishes your melee pokes early
Q hook unlocks all-in before he scales
Feast true damage threatens low-HP dives
Titanic Hydra/Cleaver DPS outscales his stacking
Cho's Feast stacks make him a true tank

start.why: The 85.3% pick rate and 48.4% winrate (64 games) reflect what you need here: sustain through Vorpal Spikes poke trades while you wait for Q to come online at level 3.

boots.why: 59.4% pick, 46.3% WR over 41 games — magic resist blunts Rupture and Feral Scream's magic damage, and the tenacity shortens how long Feral Scream's silence locks down your combo.

core.why: Sustained HP and AoE-adjacent auto damage that keeps scaling as Cho'Gath stacks max health through Feast.
Armor shred lets your extended Q-W-E trades keep outdamaging his growing HP pool.
The 33.3% WR over 6 games on this path is small sample, but the shield is the direct counter to a level-6+ Feast true-damage burst.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to split-push off the lane advantage
the game drags and you need more sustain in extended skirmishes
you're snowballing early solo kills and want to close out duels faster

runes.keystoneWhy: The 27.6%-pick page running Conqueror posts 47.6% WR — stacking adaptive force through the extended melee trades this lane produces (Vorpal Spikes exchanges, hook-yank-W all-ins) is exactly where Conqueror pays off against a tanky target.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 72.4% of games at 47.3% WR — Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills by denying Cho's Carnivore sustain and burning through any last-second Feast/heal attempt.

playing.title: All-in right after his Rupture
playing.detail: The instant Cho throws Rupture (9s cooldown), hook him with Q and go — he has no answer but autos for 9 full seconds.

playing.title: Don't facecheck a loaded Rupture
playing.detail: If Rupture is up, don't dash E into him first — the knockup/slow into a 300-range Feral Scream silence can lock your whole combo out.

playing.title: Track his Feast cooldown post-6
playing.detail: Feast (60s cooldown, 175 range, true damage) spikes after level 6 — don't stay at HP he can execute with it, and watch for it resetting his cooldown on a kill.

playing.title: Save E to dodge Rupture
playing.detail: Jousting's dash can duck the Rupture knockup/slow if you see it coming; recast it to dash back through him for the second hit once you're past the window.

playing.title: Chain Q into W, not before
playing.detail: Don't pop Violent Tendencies until the Bear Trap yank lands — the attack speed window is wasted if he's still out of range.

playing.title: Fight while dismounted to remount faster
playing.detail: Trading autos into Vorpal Spikes while dismounted still builds Skaarl's courage — don't disengage dismounted trades just because Skaarl is down, that's how you get your mount back.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the matchup mechanics, cooldown interactions, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Cho’Gath’s Rupture (Q). Use Jousting [E] to dodge while using Violent Tendencies [W] once Bear Trap on a Rope [Q] lands successfully. Be careful of being killed by Cho’Gath’s Feast (R) after reaching level 6.
